match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. medium close-up. eye level. Scarlett’s face and moving reflection fill the mirrored cabinet, with the coral lipstick and bright doorway held in shallow-focus background. Scarlett pauses before the medicine-cabinet mirror with the uncapped coral lipstick in hand, surprised by the color on her skin. Then: Scarlett applies the lipstick in the moving reflection as the apartment door swings shut behind her. Camera: push-in, smooth. Characters: Scarlett: Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height with a slim, active build, warm medium skin, expressive dark eyes, and dark brown hair worn loose to the shoulders. Her face is youthful, with defined brows and a quick, open smile. Her appearance becomes visibly brighter as the coral lipstick brings color to her complexion, wearing Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried or worn. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, correct perspective and depth, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Figures have readable poses, gestures and simple expressive faces. Draw the single opening moment of the shot: each character appears exactly once, and what happens next is shown only by a few bold arrows for the camera move and the way subjects travel. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
